findings.description: The EC2 user_data script embeds a long-lived AWS access key ID (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMAAA) and matching secret access key directly in the instance's startup script. user_data is retrievable via the instance metadata service and stored in state, so these static credentials are effectively disclosed to anyone with metadata access or state read—and grant whatever permissions the key holds.

The ingress rule exposes TCP port 22 to 0.0.0.0/0, allowing SSH authentication attempts from any host on the internet. Combined with the instance's public IP and public subnet, this presents the administrative interface directly to untrusted networks and enables brute-force or exploit attempts.

No metadata_options block is set, so the instance retains the default IMDSv1, which permits unauthenticated retrieval of instance metadata. On a publicly reachable web server (public DNS output, port 80 open), an SSRF or misconfiguration in the web app could be used to harvest the instance role/keys from the metadata endpoint.

The EBS volume attached to the instance does not set encrypted = true, so data written by the portal server is stored unencrypted at rest. Anyone able to access the underlying storage or snapshots can read the contents.
The S3 bucket that receives VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration (no aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration), so log data is stored unencrypted at rest.

map_public_ip_on_launch = true causes every instance launched in this subnet to receive a public IP automatically, needlessly exposing hosts to inbound internet reachability. Exposure should be an explicit, per-instance decision rather than a subnet default.

map_public_ip_on_launch = true causes every instance launched in this subnet to receive a public IP automatically, needlessly exposing hosts to inbound internet reachability and expanding attack surface by default.

The ingress rule exposes TCP port 80 to 0.0.0.0/0. While a public web endpoint may be intended here, there is no restriction to a load balancer or proxy tier, so the origin host itself is directly reachable from the entire internet.
